original_question: What happens if I fail more than 75% of my units?
source_document_name_and_version: LSPU Student Handbook 2021 (header Date December 2021; Doc. No. LSPU-PM-LSH-01 Rev 0)
section: Undergraduate Academic Policies > Article 5 > Retention Policies
exact_supporting_passage_4_3: 4.3. Dismissal. Any student who fails in more than seventy-five percent (75%) of the total academic units enrolled shall be subject for dismissal from the College; provided that an incomplete grade shall not be included in the computation of earned units; provided further, that this shall not apply to students who receive final grades in only nine academic units.

proposed_reference_answer_from_pending_d: The Student Handbook (Undergraduate Academic Policies > Article 5 > Retention Policies, page 35) scholastic delinquency table states that failing 75% or more (nine academic units or more) results in dismissal from the College and the student is not allowed to enroll. Failing 100% is listed as permanent disqualification from the University. For context in the same article: 25%–49% is Warning; 50%–74% is Probation (load reduced). Human review must confirm the OCR table against the PDF.
